usage.outputShape: body.success (false), body.refunded (true), body.message, body.refundTx — no usable result; payment auto-refunded
quirks: Advertised price $0.013 (13000 units) does NOT match the backend's expected price.
On payment the proxy returns HTTP 200 with {success:false, refunded:true, message:'Price mismatch, you have been refunded'} and a refundTx — payment is refunded and NO image/result is produced.
Do NOT retry at the advertised price; the mismatch is a backend config issue and every attempt will refund.
x402helper.xyz proxy charge-then-refund pattern: 200 status is misleading; the body indicates failure.
usage.guide: Do not use this endpoint as-is. The registry-advertised x402 price ($0.013 / 13000 units on Base USDC) does not match what the x402helper.xyz proxy expects. A paid GET returns HTTP 200 but with body {success:false, refunded:true, message:'Price mismatch, you have been refunded'} plus a refundTx — you get no image and the USDC is refunded. The endpoint is effectively broken until the correct price is determined; do not retry at the surfaced price.
